grounding.claim: Rule 'The map server answers only the person sitting at this machine. It listens on the loopback address and nowhere else. A request that names any other site is refused. A request that changes the remembered project list must carry a private marker header.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:800 — The server binds to the loopback address, so nothing off this machine can connect.
grounding.note: Read serve() at lines 788-813. Line 800 is `httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), Handler)` — the bind address is the loopback literal, with no host/interface option anywhere in serve()'s signature or the usage text.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The map server answers only the person sitting at this machine. It listens on the loopback address and nowhere else. A request that names any other site is refused. A request that changes the remembered project list must carry a private marker header.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:577 — Every read request whose claimed site is not loopback is refused.
grounding.note: Read do_GET at 576-595 and _loopback_host at 527-538. Line 577 is `if not _loopback_host(self.headers.get("Host", "")):` and line 578 returns 403 'host not allowed'. It is the first statement in do_GET, so it gates every read request; a Host naming any other site is refused (an absent Host is allowed, which is not a named site).

grounding.claim: Rule 'The map server answers only the person sitting at this machine. It listens on the loopback address and nowhere else. A request that names any other site is refused. A request that changes the remembered project list must carry a private marker header.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:599 — The same site check refuses a write request.
grounding.note: Read do_POST at 597-610. Line 598 repeats `if not _loopback_host(self.headers.get("Host", "")):` and line 599 is the `return self._send(403, ..., b"host not allowed")` that carries out the refusal for a write request. Same check as do_GET, one line earlier than the anchor.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The map server answers only the person sitting at this machine. It listens on the loopback address and nowhere else. A request that names any other site is refused. A request that changes the remembered project list must carry a private marker header.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:601 — A write request without the private marker header is refused.
grounding.note: Read do_POST. Line 601 is `if self.headers.get("X-Coyodex") != "serve":` and line 602 returns 403 'missing X-Coyodex header'. It runs before any body is read, so /api/open, /api/forget and /api/reorder — the three recents-list writers routed at line 604 — are unreachable without that header.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The server shows only project folders the user has opened before. It never searches the disk for maps. An address naming any other project is refused. A folder can be added only when it already holds a coyodex folder.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:799 — The served set is built from the remembered list alone, with no disk search.
grounding.note: Read serve() 788-803 and build_projects at 213-227. Line 799 is `Handler.projects = build_projects(store.list())`; build_projects only iterates the folders it is handed and calls load_project on each. Nothing walks or globs the disk looking for maps, and the docstring at 790-791 says so.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The code viewer opens a file only when it sits inside the project being shown. A path that climbs out of the project is refused. A link that points outside the project is refused too. From the working tree only files version control accounts for are served.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:285 — An absolute or otherwise malformed path is rejected before any read.
grounding.note: Read _safe_rel at 283-287. Line 285 is `if not path or path.startswith("/") or "\\" in path or "\x00" in path:` returning False on line 286. It is a pure predicate called by git_show (277), worktree_read (324) and the /api/src route (697) before any read happens.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The code viewer opens a file only when it sits inside the project being shown. A path that climbs out of the project is refused. A link that points outside the project is refused too. From the working tree only files version control accounts for are served.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:287 — A path containing a step up to the parent folder is rejected.
grounding.note: Read _safe_rel at 283-287. Line 287 is `return ".." not in Path(path).parts` — any path component equal to '..' makes the predicate False, so a climb to the parent folder is rejected.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The code viewer opens a file only when it sits inside the project being shown. A path that climbs out of the project is refused. A link that points outside the project is refused too. From the working tree only files version control accounts for are served.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:697 — The code request refuses a bad path before touching disk or version control.
grounding.note: Read the ['src'] branch at 695-714. Line 696 pulls `path` from the query, line 697 is `if not _safe_rel(path):` and line 698 returns 400 'bad path'. The worktree read (703) and the git blob read (711) both sit below it, so nothing touches disk or git first.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The code viewer opens a file only when it sits inside the project being shown. A path that climbs out of the project is refused. A link that points outside the project is refused too. From the working tree only files version control accounts for are served.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:324 — A working-tree read refuses anything inside the version-control folder.
grounding.note: Read worktree_read at 319-343. Line 324 is `if not _safe_rel(path) or path.split("/", 1)[0] == ".git":` returning None on 325 — a working-tree read whose first path segment is the version-control folder is refused before the resolve() on line 327.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The code viewer opens a file only when it sits inside the project being shown. A path that climbs out of the project is refused. A link that points outside the project is refused too. From the working tree only files version control accounts for are served.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:331 — The real resolved location must still sit inside the project, so a link cannot escape.
grounding.note: Read worktree_read. Line 327-328 resolve(strict=True) both the file and the repo root, then line 331 is `if not real.is_relative_to(real_root) or ".git" in real.relative_to(real_root).parts:` returning None. Because it tests the RESOLVED location, a tracked symlink pointing outside the project fails the check.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The code viewer opens a file only when it sits inside the project being shown. A path that climbs out of the project is refused. A link that points outside the project is refused too. From the working tree only files version control accounts for are served.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:338 — A file version control ignores is refused, so an ignored secrets file never leaks.
grounding.note: Read worktree_read 335-339. Line 335 runs `git ls-files --error-unmatch`; when the file is not tracked, line 337 runs `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` and line 338 is `if code2 != 0 or path not in out2.decode(...).splitlines(): return None`. --exclude-standard omits gitignored files, so an ignored .env falls into this return and is never read.

grounding.claim: Rule 'A link that leaves the page may open only a known code editor. The address must start with one of a fixed list of editor schemes. A hand-typed link template using any other scheme is refused.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/viewer.js:10684 — An address outside the allowed editor list never becomes a clickable link.
grounding.note: Read editorUri at 10672-10685 and the ALLOWED_OPEN_SCHEMES set at 10622-10625. Line 10684 is `return ALLOWED_OPEN_SCHEMES.has(uriScheme(uri)) ? uri : null;` — the filled template is returned only when its scheme is in the fixed editor set, otherwise null, so no href is produced.

grounding.claim: Rule 'A link that leaves the page may open only a known code editor. The address must start with one of a fixed list of editor schemes. A hand-typed link template using any other scheme is refused.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/viewer.js:10815 — Saving a custom link template is refused when its scheme is not on the list.
grounding.note: Read saveSettings at 10809-10825. Line 10815 is `if (!ALLOWED_OPEN_SCHEMES.has(uriScheme(custom))) {` and 10816-10817 set the error 'Scheme not allowed — use an editor scheme' and `return`, so the lsSet writes on line 10824 never run for a custom template with a disallowed scheme.

grounding.claim: Rule 'The viewer page loads its two diagram libraries from the internet at exact pinned versions. Each one carries a fingerprint of the expected file. The browser refuses to run a file whose content does not match that fingerprint.' is enforced at tools/coyodex/viewer/viewer.html:17 — The pan and zoom library is pinned by fingerprint.
grounding.note: Read the head at lines 13-21. Line 16 loads svg-pan-zoom@3.6.1 (the pan and zoom library) at an exact version and line 17 is `integrity="sha384-yc/c2Lk1s2V2ir1rxvjo8YyVD9PlOlYTqpNr3Wm1WIuAA30GlDYNx6U5104OiavY"`, with crossorigin="anonymous" on 18 so the browser can enforce Subresource Integrity.
